Question:
What is the customer price of the engine oil pressure switch, P/N 83278?

Source: TRAIN-AD, section 4
The engine oil pressure switch
P/N 83278, 3,000 hours Replace with a new, zero-time switch Record part number, date, and airframe hours

Source: WO-2025-0095, section Work
Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11.
Removed switch P/N 83278 at 2,951.3 hours since installation.
Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-037.

Source: WO-SCAN, section Work
Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11 paragraph (g)(6) and Cessna Service Bulletin SB 07-79-01.
Removed switch P/N 83278 at 3,000.4 hours since installation. Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks.
Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-014.
Performed by: Y. Alaoui
Approved for return to service: A.Tazi alaouí
tazi

Source: AD-2013-11-11, section (g)
83278 engine oil pressure switch, replace it with a new, zero time, P/N 83278 engine oil pressure switch. Record the engine oil pressure switch part number, date, and airplane hours in the airplane log book. The recorded engine oil pressure switch TIS will be used as the benchmark for calculation of the 3,000 hour TIS limit on the engine oil pressure switch.

Source: WO-2025-0095, section Parts
Part number Description Quantity Serial number
83278 Engine oil pressure switch 1 
Certification: the work above was performed in accordance with 14 CFR Part 43 and the procedures manual. The aircraft is airworthy for the work performed.
Performed by: N. Berrada
Return to service: A. Tazi, licence MA-B1-0457
